prompt: Create one transparent game tutorial icon atlas for a cozy handcrafted clay farm game. Very wide landscape canvas, exactly 3:1 aspect ratio. Divide the canvas into exactly three equal square cells arranged horizontally; each icon must stay centered within its own cell with generous 12% padding and completely transparent gutters. Left cell: a small warm brown square patch of tilled soil with a fresh green two-leaf sprout and a few golden seeds, communicates planting. Middle cell: a rounded turquoise watering can tilted with three large blue water droplets pouring onto a green sprout on soil, communicates watering. Right cell: a honey wicker harvest basket holding ripe red tomatoes, golden corn and an orange carrot with leafy tops, communicates harvest. All three are polished matte 3D clay miniatures, chunky rounded shapes, warm soft studio lighting from upper left, consistent scale and perspective, subtle contact shadow only under each icon. No text, no numbers, no frames, no arrows, no scenery, no labels, no additional items. Actual transparent alpha background. The three square cells must be equally sized, fully separated and not overlap so this can be used as a three-column CSS sprite sheet.
